info.title: Biohub CellTrack Pipeline (norel7)
info.subtitle: Cell tracking inference ILP postprocess pipeline for biohub
info.description: Complete inference pipeline for biohub-cell-tracking-during-development: predict_local.py (D4 TTA, sidecar, ILP), postprocess.py (NB2 clean postprocess with motion-relink/safe-div switches), division_recover.py, the tracking_cellmot baseline package, pilkwang support-pack 50ep edge_predictor_best.pth, and offline cp312 wheels (tracksdata/geff/ilpy/pyscipopt/blosc2/dask).
